incident.symptom: Daily intelligence loops existed, but verified action outcomes were under-projected into Outcome Memory and whole-brain/universal-learning integrity was not scheduled daily.
incident.root_cause: Outcome capture, forecast resolution and daily estate-wide integrity checks were separate capabilities without one evidence-gated daily compound-learning prerequisite.
incident.prior_evidence: Production had 6 sales outcomes, 13 done actions, 3 resolved forecasts and non-daily Whole Brain / Universal Closed-loop workflows.

prevention: Capture only verified observed runtime outcomes into the existing powerhouse_sales_outcomes store.
Exclude smoke, test, synthetic and fixture events from learning.
Never infer a negative result from silence or missing provider evidence.
Resolve eligible forecasts only from explicit verified outcomes.
Run Whole Brain Canonical Loop daily.
Require the compound-learning controls in Daily Self Evolution.
